decisions: BOM takes precedence over declared meta charset; UTF-8 is the strict default.
Reuse native_ods._cell_ref and native_workbook bounds; no new dependency.
Row spans stop at existing row-group boundaries; rowspan=0 covers the remaining group, never invented rows.
Missing positions are omitted; explicit empty strings and whitespace retain distinct states.
Malformed span attributes default to one; overlapping spans fail closed with NATIVE_HTML_INVALID.
Multiple direct nested tables cite the first through nestedSheet and all through nestedSheets.
gaps: CSS visibility/browser layout are not evaluated; downstream selection/redaction must exclude private source text.
Outside ownership: document-native.ts still identifies HTML as text; documentReaderSha needs the HTML module.
DocumentLocatorSchema rejects HTML caption/spanOf/nestedSheet(s), spanned/nested_table and missing sheetId/ODS.
document-native.ts filters empty parts; DocumentPartSchema requires nonempty text. HTML import is unqualified.
OpenAPI regeneration and an officer-reviewed end-to-end import remain lead-owned; no full GF-AGENT pass claimed.

privacy.retained: Only counts and selected non-personal development header rows.
privacy.excluded: Whole HTML, contacts/bank sections and all extracted data-cell text remain outside Git.
